mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities that increase infection risk in immunosuppressed patients receiving TNF-alpha inhibitors, and both drugs increase immunosuppression leading to opportunistic infections.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes closely; use liposomal amphotericin B formulation if possible to reduce nephrotoxicity; consider temporary suspension of etanercept during amphotericin B therapy if clinically feasible.
